selected.model: Met1-iRFP orthotopic breast tumors in female FVB mice; voluntary wheel running vs sedentary (no wheel) from day 3 after implantation (S2.1.2.p1, S2.2.p1)
selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (KAPA stranded mRNA, HiSeq 50bp PE), STAR mm10 + featureCounts gencode vM18 (S2.4.p1)
selected.fractions: tumors digested and flow-sorted into iRFP+ cancer cells and iRFP- TME cells from the same tumors (S2.4.p1, S3.p4)
selected.sample_inclusion: TME fraction: exercise n=4 vs sedentary n=4 (FIG2 C); cancer-cell fraction: exercise n=7 vs sedentary n=8 (FIG3 B)
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of exercise (wheel running vs sedentary) on gene expression, estimated separately within each sorted fraction: (1) TME iRFP- cells, (2) cancer iRFP+ cells
planned_contrasts: TME iRFP-: Exercise vs Sedentary, DESeq2 (S3.p2, FIG2 C; paper: 87 DEGs at padj < 0.1)
Cancer iRFP+: Exercise vs Sedentary, DESeq2 (S3.p4, FIG3 B; paper: 293 DEGs at padj < 0.1)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none within a fraction (one sample per mouse per fraction); the two fractions come from the same tumors but are analyzed separately
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 per fraction, Exercise vs control (S2.4.p1); GSEA on log2FC-ranked genes with mouse Hallmark via genekitr (S2.4.p1); Reactome on up/down DEGs and IPA (S3.p4)

paper_results.named_cancer_genes: HMGB2 targets up: Iqgap3, Cenpe, Cenpf, Dlgap5, Kif23, Kif2c, Mki67, Ncaph (written 'Nacph'), Top2a, Tpx2, Anln, Hmmr; down: Hist3h2a (written 'Hist3ha'). CTF1 targets: down Etfb, Thrsp, Postn; up Plcb4, Med13, Fasn, Tgm2 (S3.p8, S4.p6)

decisions.reason: Methods S2.4.p1 define the RNA-seq assay, sorting into iRFP+ and iRFP- fractions, featureCounts counts and DESeq2. Results S3.p2 (TME, 87 DEGs, padj < 0.1, n=4 vs 4 per FIG2 C) and S3.p4 (cancer cells, 293 DEGs, padj < 0.1, n=7 vs 8 per FIG3 B) give two separate exercise-vs-control contrasts. No fold-change cutoff is stated. GEO metadata sample counts match the figure legends exactly.

checks: 23 GEO samples = 15 cancer (8 SED, 7 EX) + 8 TME (4 SED, 4 EX), matching FIG3 B and FIG2 C n
matrix has 23 columns whose names equal the GEO 'Library name' in description
GEO data_processing text is identical to S2.4.p1 (STAR AllBestScore, featureCounts, gencode vM18)

decisions.reason: The paper's data availability statement S8.p1 deposits RNA-seq under GSE304653; sample counts and processing text match the paper.
